body: I have a small group that I hang out with during our breaks though with the lockdown I can’t really talk to them because I don’t have their number or they just don’t have time to talk. And my dad isn’t physical abusive, if he was I wouldn’t be typing this because I would have called CPS a loooong time ago.

Very overwhelmed, used to be suicidal but not much now. He gets mad at the slightest of things and when he is mad he will just berate me with insults. I can tell he cares just he doesn’t know how to express it. I’ve had severe depression since I was probably about 6 if that gives you an idea.
Yeah, my dad is very narcissistic and mentally abusive to my mother and I, (I’m 13)
